title: University Gets Lake Austin Easement Approved
summary:
*   **Lake Austin Easement Granted:** The City approved an easement to a university for a portion of the Lake Austin lake bed, specifically abutting the Boat Town Tract.
*   **Brackenridge Agreement Clarified:** This land use change was presented as a clarification and addition to the existing Brackenridge Development Agreement.
*   **Unanimous Decision:** The resolution for the easement was passed with a 7-0 vote, indicating full consensus on the matter.
